name: Crying
overview: Scripture reveals that crying is a sincere expression of the heart that God attentively observes and responds to, as seen in Psalms where the Lord’s eyes and ears are open to the righteous in their distress. The Psalms emphasize that the righteous cry out and God delivers them from their troubles, affirming His compassionate care. Furthermore, God values our tears personally, recording them as precious, and through tears sown in times of hardship, joy and restoration are ultimately reaped. The Lord’s promise to Hezekiah also highlights that God not only hears prayers but sees tears, responding with mercy and extending life.
